segments.ch11.s0010: The King and Queen of Hearts sat on their throne.
segments.ch11.s0020: A great crowd was gathered about them.
segments.ch11.s0030: There were little birds and beasts, and the whole pack of cards.
segments.ch11.s0040: The Knave stood before them in chains, with a soldier on each side.
segments.ch11.s0050: Near the King stood the White Rabbit, with a trumpet and a scroll.
segments.ch11.s0060: In the middle of the court was a table, with a large dish of tarts upon it.
segments.ch11.s0070: I wish they would get the trial done, and hand round the refreshments!
segments.ch11.s0080: That is the judge, because of his great wig.
segments.ch11.s0090: The judge was the King, and he wore his crown over the wig.
segments.ch11.s0110: Those twelve creatures must be the jurors.
segments.ch11.s0130: The White Rabbit blew three blasts on the trumpet.
segments.ch11.s0140: The Queen of Hearts, she made some tarts, all on a summer day.
segments.ch11.s0150: The Knave of Hearts, he stole those tarts, and took them quite away!
segments.ch11.s0180: There is a great deal to come before that!
